title: Tool output
description: A machine-checkable record of one model checker's or prover's own run (V2-10). A status of model-checked or proven needs the tool's output and exit code, not only the existence of an artifact: a model file proves that a model exists, while this record proves that a tool ran over it and what it said. It does not prove the tool's semantics or the soundness of the encoding; a forger can rewrite the record and its output together without an external anchor (C-13).

tool.description: Tool that produced the verdict, e.g. 'TLC', 'Alloy', 'Apalache', 'Z3', 'Rodin'.

version.description: Tool version. The verdict means little without it; a version upgrade can change the answer.

command.description: Exact command, including the bound, configuration or model path.

commit.description: Commit the run executed at. Must equal the evidence commit when the evidence names one.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. A non-zero code cannot support a non-open status.

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an offset. Its local date must equal the evidence date.

output.description: Path to the captured tool output, relative to --tool-output-root (default: the project root at --root), or a URL, in which case the hash is not checked.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the output bytes. Lint check L2 verifies it.

verdict.description: The tool's own result line, quoted: e.g. 'No error has been found', 'no counterexample within bound 8'. L2 does not parse it; it exists so a reviewer can compare the claim with what the tool said.

bound.description: State-space or depth bound for a bounded check. model-checked claims must state theirs, otherwise the status overstates what was explored.
